thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the 2069-deploy I'm seeing a jump in slow-path activity on the prefix KV. Hitrate dipped and slow_path_calls spiked. Can we run an adaptive probe sweep to verify whether the sample-rate/backoff tuning regressed?

vik: Ack. Can you paste the metrics you saw and which cluster/node?

maria: Canary cluster node-c3. Short paste from the metric window:
```
prefix_cache.hitrate 0.94 -> 0.87 over 2h
prefix_cache.slow_path_calls 9.8k -> 31.2k
kv.prefetch.miss_ratio 0.06 -> 0.18
```
This lines up with more slow-path pathing in the runtime and a modest eviction uptick. Not sure if it's probe/sample-rate or the compact cycle timing.

sam: I can run a sweep on canary this afternoon. What exact params do you want tested? probe/sample/backoff combos?

maria: Yeah — need a matrix: probe-rate = [0.05,0.1,0.2], sample-window = [1m,5m], backoff-ms = [10,50,200]. Keep each run ~10m steady-state after warmup. Also collect these counters: prefix_cache.hitrate, prefix_cache.slow_path_calls, prefix_cache.eviction_rate, prefetch.latency_{p50,p95}.

lee: +1 on capturing histograms for prefetch latency. Also add kv.keysize distribution tag — we saw skew earlier.

maria: Suggested run command (copyable):
```
./tools/loadgen --suite=prefix-adaptive-sweep \
  --duration=600 \
  --warmup=120 \
  --probe-rate=0.1 \
  --sample-window=60 \
  --backoff-ms=50 \
  --tags=canary,node-c3
```
Outputs will go to /tmp/bench-<ts>.tar.gz with metrics.json + profiles.

ops-bot: Scheduling note: canary maintenance window 2026-03-17 17:00-18:00 UTC reserved for perf runs. Please annotate run jobs with #canary-window.

sam: I'll start first sweep at 17:05 UTC. Will run the 3x3 matrix but stop early if we blow latency SLO. Report back with a short table.

toni: If you hit the regression again capture a perf flame (`perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 10`) and upload the script, I can do a quick hotspot diff.

sam: Run 1 finished. Quick summary (probe-rate=0.1 sample-window=60 backoff-ms=50):
```
prefix_cache.hitrate: 0.872
prefix_cache.slow_path_calls: 31234
prefix_cache.eviction_rate: 0.0037
prefetch.latency_p95_ms: 18.2
```
Looks similar to the regression. Attaching metrics.json -> /tmp/bench-2069991234-1/metrics.json

lee: Thanks. Can you re-run with probe-rate=0.05 & backoff-ms=200? That combination should reduce probe pressure and give us lower slow_path.

sam: Kicking that now. Will tag results.

maria: Plan after runs: 1) confirm whether lower probe-rate/backoff reduces slow_path without hurting hitrate 2) if not, add extra logging around the slow-path decision code and roll a small canary build with more counters 3) schedule a deeper profile run if hotspots persist.

vik: Sounds good. If sam sees anything weird ping eng-sre and let's not run at the same time as other noisy jobs. Keep notes in the bench PR.

sam: Will do. Will paste final table here + link to perf artifacts when done. :thumbsup:
